name: Rootwater Matriarch — gain control of target creature for as long as that creature is enchanted
notes: Memory: project_rootwater_matriarch_that_creature_is_enchanted_2026-10-18. "{T}: Gain control of target creature for as long as that creature is enchanted." The condition is the target's, not the Matriarch's: the opponent's Gray Ogre enchanted with Pacifism comes under Player 1's control; the opponent's Giant Spider, also enchanted but not the target, and the Matriarch's untargeted neighbours stay where they are. A target with no Aura stays with its owner (second fire), even with the Matriarch itself enchanted.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Giant Spider
scryfallData.oracle_text: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
scryfallData.flavor_text: The giant spider's silk naturally resists gravity, almost weaving itself as it blankets the forest canopy.

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.
